notes.title: Steam Summer Sale Update and 25% Off Discount!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Mercenaries here is the latest patch notes hot off the presses. 

Please remember to review the game as that helps with visibility, The game is now 25% off so be sure to tell all your friends! We've also added spanish and russian localizaiton and are Steam Deck verified! Check out our friends over at Jofer's Games with Pixel Paint Together and it's new Wyvia themed free DLC! Sale ends July 11th!

If there's an issue that hasn't been resolved below please visit the forums or discord to report your issues. 

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Wyvern Statue Upgrade Menu not translating properly in other languages besides English
[*] Fixed being able to use Comfy Coacoa while in a Monster Arena or during the Final Boss fight
[*] Fixed Mana Well restoring x10 more mana than it should
[*] Fixed Spelling mistakes and typos in text and dialogue
[/list]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Spanish Localization
[*] Added Russian Localization
[*] User Interface Adjustments
[*] Steam Deck Optimizations.
[*] Steam Deck Verified!
[*] Towns now have proper Icons in Menus.
[*] Crit numbers are now easier to read (removed the !!! at the end of numbers)
[*] Comfy Coacoa can no longer be used while in Wyvern Form.
[/list]

[b]BALANCING[/b]
[list]
[*] Mana Well now Restores up to 5% MP every 5 seconds (or 10% with all Wyvern Statue upgrades).
[*] Reduced the player's recovery time after taking a hit from 1 to 0.5 seconds.
[*] Reduced the time between attacks for most enemies.
[*] Increased Physical and Magical defenses of all monsters and bosses, even the secret one.
[*] Enemies now have proper resistances to status effects (lava monsters didnt have resistance to Burn before)
[/list]

Be sure to wishlist our new game coming out soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712380/Legends_of_Dragaea_Idle_Dungeons/

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello fellow Mercenaries here is the latest patch notes hot off the presses. 

Please remember to review the game as that helps your fellow gamers find the game and us with visibility, 

If there's an issue that hasn't been resolved below please visit the forums or discord to report your issues. 

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Staff's Beam not scaling with Speed Bonus stat
[*] Fixed Wyvan Village's Wyvern Statue saying you get +20 Skill points and +10 stat points when its the other way around
[*] Fixed familiars all having the same favorite food
[*] Can no longer swim out of bounds when swimming off the lava ring around Wyvern Castle
[*] Fixed Ninja's Dexterity Increase skill giving you 3% more Dex per point instead of 2%. (Sorry Ninja chads)
[*] Fixed Hunter's Bandolier skill not working with Ninja's Double skill
[*] Fixed Barbarian's Twister skill not working with Ninja's Double skill
[/list]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Guild Lady's official name is now "Karen", set your character name to this and it'll unlock the Guild Lady sprite.
[*] Added a set of Teleporters that teleports you from the Entrance of Wyvern Castle to the End and vice versa, they appear after you beat the game.
[*] Total Chests Opened achievement now rechecks after reloading save file. (incase it bugged and didnt apply the first time you get the required amount)
[*] When feeding familiars, the cursor no longer resets to the first button if you still have more of that item after feeding
[/list]

[b]BALANCING[/b] (oh noooooo)
[list]
[*] Increased Goopy Summon damage from 40% to 60% of your Magical Attack as Damage
[*] Increased Ghost Summon damage from 60% to 80% of your Magical Attack as Damage
[*] Summoned monster attack speeds now scale with Speed Bonus stat
[*] Decreased Staff's passive bonus from 48% to 12% for every 250 of your Maximum Mana
[*] Increased stats of all bosses after the 2nd boss.
[*] Increased stats of all bosses after the 2nd boss.
[*] Increased stats of some monsters.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello fellow Mercenaries here is the latest patch notes hot off the presses. 

Please remember to review the game as that helps your fellow gamers find the game and us with visibiliity, We are blown away by how much everyone has loved the game.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello fellow Mercenaries here is the latest patch notes hot off the presses. 

Please remember to review the game as that helps your fellow gamers find the game and us with visibiliity, We are blown away by how much everyone has loved the game. 

If there's an issue that hasn't been resolved below please visit the forums or discord to report your issues. 

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Intensify damage calculations (it works now)
[*] Fixed Gelato sprite not appearing on the main menu if you saved with it on
[*] Fixed Ninja's Flicker ability not working on Huge Knights
[*] Fixed Snow's name not appearing in the Monster Diary
[*] Fixed typo in Comfy Cocoa's name
[*] Fixed typo in Obsidioth's description
[*] Redesigned monster portal arenas so softlocks no longer happen
[*] Fixed delinquent bangle's damage bonus
[*] Fixed debt warrant's damage bonus
[*] Fixed all bling up achievements sharing the same name
[*] Fixed magical spring not fitting in the active statuses HUD background.
[*] Surge Orbs and Glyphs now clear when you enter a new area
[/list]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a few more Huge Knights to the world map, just a few
[*] Flying eyes in Haunted House and Dark Temple now follow you around, making the fake wall puzzles less painful to traverse.
[*] Increased the maximum amount of surge orbs to 100 at one time. (am I gonna regret this? probably)
[*] Added "Mr Sneaker" sprites created by my brother. You can unlock by finishing the game or naming yourself "Sneaker" (not case sensitive)
[*] Mountain clouds on the Main Menu screen now animate
[*] Monster locations are now revealed on the map screen after you finish the game
[*] Escape key brings up the quit menu in the main menu screen
[/list]

[b]BALANCING[/b] (oh noooo)
[list]
[*] Joker's Joke skill and Hysterical effects no longer works on bosses
[*] Added an exp penalty for monsters spawned from the Monster Respawn Portals. penalty depends on the rates, starting at 2.5% less exp from x2 enemies to 25% less exp from x10 enemies. Gold amounts have not been touched. (you still get a ton of exp from monsters spawned this way)
[*] Wayfarer's Scavenge skill now starts at 11 seconds from 15 seconds, and decreases by 0.5 seconds per skill point invested.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2
notes.content:
Fresh off the presses. As always if you have issues please visit forums or discord to report any bug issues.

If you're enjoying the game please consider leaving a review as that helps us with visibility and helps other gamers find out how great Wyvia is.

Have a wonderful weekend.

FIXES
- fixed options not saving properly
- fixed controls not saving properly
- fixed text overlap in Achievements Menu
- made it a lot harder for the player and enemies to go through walls
- status effects and ailments no longer countdown while speaking to an NPC or interacting with a monster respawn portal
- bosses no longer follow you back to towns
- fixed only being able to buy Wyvern Scales from a trader if carrying less than 60 scales
- fixed equipped accessories not saving properly
- fixed softlocking the player out of a few chests permanently if they fought the secret boss before
- Golden Palance now has 10 Wyvern Scales
- fixed description of the Pouch Mastery skill
- fixed familiars stat boosts

FEATURES
- Steam Achievements are now checked on save file load, if you acquired an achievement but it didnt activate, try reloading for it to take effect.
- item get popups now merge if you get the same items and do a cute icon animation

MORE ON THE WAY

notes.title: v1.0.1
notes.content:
FIXES
- fixed intensify
- fixed music not playing in prologue
- fixed music not playing in ending credits
- removed NEW SPRITE in the Achievements Menu, this was a leftover mechanic I changed a while back, instead you unlock new sprites by leveling up a class or from beating the game, or naming your character something specific (more on that below)
- removed the "dont sleep" button at the inn as it didnt serve any purpose.
- fixed the King causing a crash when you try to talk to him while he's hiding in a pot.
- Knight's Skill Giant now deactivates when you enter a new area/town or when transforming.
- fixed map screen breaking and not showing any maps when you explore too many areas
- fixed some cornfield sprites not displaying correctly
- fixed wyvern scales not showing up in Secret Tunnel, there are now 5 again in there.
- plugged up a hold in the wall in Cold Cave that lets you walk out of bounds and leave the map
- switched the EXP LEFT colors around so they match their respective EXP Bar colors
- plugged up the hole in Guild Lady's floor in New Castleton
- fixed Spicy Lychee not working after eating it
- fixed pushblock puzzles in Secret Stash Cave
- fixed reset buttons in Secret Stash Cave
- fixed Joker skills having incorrect names
- fixed Joker's Party skill
- fixed Joker's Counterfeit skill not equippable in Active Skills menu
- fixed Yeetus' Hands not displaying their Health Bars correctly
- fixed the water in Seasonal Cave
- fixed the lava in High Temple

FEATURES
- added cloud saving
- implemented a save backup feature, now your save files will be backed up automatically
- game window can now be resized freely in windowed mode.
- World Map now has its own Monster Counter
- You can now input a specific name in the Name Input screen to unlock a skin from the getgo without finishing the game to unlock it.
Names that unlock a skin (not case sensitive):
- Aozora
- Banker

- Knight

- Perfect
- Trader
- Warm
- Wyvan
- NPC

MORE ON THE WAY

notes.title: Patch Notes for Prologue Version 0.4.9
notes.content:
Wyvia Prologue 0.4.9 Patch Notes


CHANGES

- Clouds on worldmap mountains now animate
- Made the sun brightness not so glaring while on sand biome
- The Nothing equip in the Equipment menu now shows a Fist Attack sprite and is called Fist
- Gate Switches now pulse red when not pressed, the pressed sprite is also darker
- Added a new character sprite to choose: Royal Knight (Defeated)
- Added proper flavor descriptions for Materials

FIXES

- Fixed Scavenge only giving you Food items, now also gives you materials.
- Fixed Wyvernform Map Abilities not updating after you grab the 2nd Wyvern Crystal, can now swim through the Secret Tunnel (FOR SURE THIS TIME)
- Fixed destroyables (pots, barrels, trees) showering you with 1000s of gold if hit with multiple projectiles at the same time
- Fixed being able to swim in water on a new save if you gained Wyvernform Swimming Ability on another
- Fixed the one waterfall missing a wall collider
- Fixed the Bank giving you an interest every minute, this was a leftover mechanic I forgot to fully remove and just maxes out your gold too quickly. Will be replaced with a better mechanic in the full game. (maybe an upgradeable bank?)
- Fixed Enormous Egg going past 10 quantity
- Fixed Big Breath always dealing 1 damage no matter how many points were put into it
